summary: Create a scheduled job that invokes one op in the future or on a recurrence.

summary.description: Short human-readable description of the scheduled job.

details.description: Optional longer explanation of the job's purpose.

origin_reference.description: Optional caller-owned reference used to correlate this job with an external object.

schedule_type.description: Schedule discriminator. Must match the definition type.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret calendar schedules, for example America/New_York or UTC.

definition.description: Schedule definition. one_time uses run_at; interval uses interval_count and interval_unit; calendar_rule uses rrule; conditional uses predicate fields.

job_action.description: Action to execute. Currently supports {type: op_invocation, op_id, input_payload}.

start_state.description: Initial lifecycle state. Use active when the schedule should begin firing.

output_schema.description: Job mutation result containing the created job and audit row.
